title: Freizeitzentrum Badesee Weisslahn
highlights: Glasklarer Grundwasserbadesee mit gepflegten Liegewiesen und schattenspendenden Bäumen
Grosses Freizeitangebot mit Tennisplaetzen, Beachvolleyball, Minigolf und Slacklines

kurzbeschreibung: The Freizeitzentrum Weisslahn in Terfens features an idyllic swimming lake with sunbathing lawns and a diverse range of sports facilities.
beschreibung:
Summer Retreat in the Inntal

The Badesee Weisslahn in Terfens is a popular recreational oasis in the Unterinntal. Fed by crystal-clear groundwater, the lake stands out with its premium water quality and beautiful setting amidst the alpine scenery of the Silberregion Karwendel.

Active Leisure and Relaxation by the Water

Sun worshippers find ample space on the spacious sunbathing lawns. Sports enthusiasts enjoy beach volleyball courts, tennis courts, and minigolf courses, while children can splash safely in the shallow shore areas and have fun in the playgrounds.
